title: why when I don't have gate selected it seems I'm getting gate respondes in chat [image 1]
summary: Now let's see where the classifier is called in the turn path, and whether it's conditional on gate being selected.That footer doesn't mean Gate answered you. The reply came from `claude-opus-5-5`. The `gate: claude-haiku-5-5` part is a small extra call that classifies your prompt, and it runs on every turn whether Gate is selected or not.
